title: IonianDTwin Observation
description: A single normalised observation value with provenance and explicit temporal/spatial reference. Instants use ISO 8601 with an explicit time zone; aggregate periods use temporal_granularity plus an optional period end.

indicator_name.description: Human-readable indicator name (denormalised for dashboard readiness).

series_label.description: The specific series/variable of the indicator carried by this observation.

source_id.description: References sources/source-registry.md and the verification manifest.

observed_at.description: ISO 8601. Instant observations: full datetime with explicit timezone (e.g. 2026-09-22T14:15:00+02:00). Period observations: the period start (e.g. 2023, 2023-01, 2023-01-01); set observed_period_end when the period is not implicit.

observed_period_end.description: ISO 8601 end of the aggregation period (e.g. 2023-12-31). null for instant/forecast observations.

temporal_granularity.description: Temporal resolution of the value. forecast = a projection, not a measurement.

ingested_at.description: ISO 8601 instant (UTC, 'Z') when the observation was ingested.

code.description: Spatial code (e.g. ISO 3166 alpha-2 'EL', NUTS2 'EL62', or 'lat,lon').

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry; null when not point-referenced.

value.description: Typed value; string for categorical, null for missing.

polarity.description: Direction of desirability for composite scoring: positive = higher is better.

cross_verified.description: true when a citizen report was confirmed by a sensor/official source.

raw_manifest.description: Manifest id that recorded the raw fetch.
